verdict.rationale: Sketch ships a built-in local MCP Server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch. Its AI page markets natural-language-driven operations through a connected client: recreating styles and components from a repo, sorting, renaming and aligning layers, swapping light and dark components, replacing placeholder text, and building frames out in code. missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface (operation depends on bringing your own MCP client), detailed docs on the range of commands supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works in practice.
